name: Chouhou Buin
source:
Main character John gets a message from the Director of Space and Aeronautics. He has trouble finding the place, so he travels on foot and asks around.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角约翰收到了太空与航空总监的消息。他找不到地方，所以他徒步旅行并四处打听。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
